note: Thin lexical reference for the IP/MPLS L3VPN case. Identity-only entries. It has NO entry for proprietary/opaque items (x-op-tag-91, vrf-tag-0x7): those carry no public meaning and remain residual. route-distinguisher and route-target are distinct entries, as are routing-policy (route-policy) and QoS (qos-profile), and customer-edge and iBGP session, so labels sharing 'route-', 'policy', or 'neighbor' bind apart.

entries.label: L3VPN instance
entries.definition: The managed layer-3 VPN as one end-to-end service across the provider network.
entries.example: the ACME L3VPN over PE1, PE2, PE3

entries.label: VRF
entries.definition: The per-PE instance of the VPN: the virtual routing and forwarding table for the customer on one device.

entries.label: network access
entries.definition: The point at which a customer site attaches to the VPN on a PE.
entries.example: the ACME attachment on PE1 toward CE-A

entries.label: customer edge
entries.definition: The customer-owned router that peers with the PE across an attachment.

entries.label: route distinguisher
entries.definition: The value prepended to a VRF's routes to make them globally unique; an identifier, not a policy.
entries.example: 65000:101 on the ACME VRF at PE1

entries.label: route target
entries.definition: The extended-community value controlling which VRFs import and export a route; a policy value, not an identifier.

entries.label: PE-CE addressing
entries.definition: The IP subnet and addresses on a PE-CE attachment.

entries.label: QoS profile
entries.definition: The quality-of-service treatment (policing, queueing) applied to traffic on an attachment.

entries.label: provider edge
entries.definition: A provider-edge router hosting the customer's VRFs.

entries.label: PE-CE routing protocol
entries.definition: The routing protocol run between a PE and a CE across an attachment.

entries.label: routing policy
entries.definition: A policy that filters and manipulates routes on import and export of a VRF; distinct from a QoS policy.
entries.example: deny customer default, set local-preference on import

entries.label: SLA report
entries.definition: A periodic conformance report on the service's SLA; a service-view construct with no device-config counterpart.
entries.example: the monthly availability report for the ACME VPN

entries.label: iBGP session
entries.definition: An internal-BGP session between PEs carrying VPN routes across the provider core; a device-config construct with no network-model counterpart, distinct from a customer-edge peer.
entries.example: the iBGP session from PE1 to PE2
